auth_refills.description: The number of refills, excluding this order, that the patient is authorized for

is_doc_med.description: If the medication order is intended to document a med instead of draft a prescription. When it is true, the object will be automatically signed as a documented medication, otherwise the object will be created as a draft prescription

medication.description: medication object (must provide one of id, ndc, rxnorm_cuis required)

id.description: Medication id

ndcs.description: The NDC code of the medication(must contains only one ndc code)

rxnorm_cuis.description: The Rxnorm.cui code of the medication(must contains only one cui code)

medication_type.description: If this is OTC or a prescription

order_type.description: If the medication order is new, a refill or a change in dosage

qty.description: The amount of the medication to order (decimal)

qty_units.description: The units that match the amount, e.g. capsules

start_date.description: The date on which the prescription started or will start.

thread.description: Refer to the medication thread documentation for more info

id.description: Thread id (NOT required)

document_date.description: The timestamp for when this prescription was first documented. Will be the same as the creation time unless this an historical data import.

documenting_personnel.description: physician object required if is_doc_med is true

get.description:
Providers are able to print a view of the lab order including the data provided behind this endpoint.

Each lab order response includes a link to obtain this view; a PDF file.

When you GET the link you'll receive a response with application/pdf and the bytes of the PDF.
